description: Send a physical letter ('Brief') to a lead's postal address via eBrief.de. Required: lead_id, and the content — either body (plain text, drawn server-side: text only, no logo or images) or document_id (a PDF already stored here, posted as it is — that is how a designed letter gets sent). Optional: subject, dry_run. This costs postage and cannot be recalled — set dry_run: true to build the letter and get a PDF link WITHOUT sending it (no eBrief.de job, no cost). Requires the lead to have a full address and eBrief.de connected.

document_id.description: A stored PDF to post as the letter, instead of body.

dry_run.description: Build the letter and return a PDF link instead of sending it. Default false.

name: send_letter
